purpose: Exercise the integrated release CLI through bounded local generation, intact-cell replay, and rejection of rehashed semantic corruption. Exclude all outputs from the research corpus.
question: Does the actual clean release binary retain and independently reconstruct the new prime affine-S3-chain input on both selected twist cells, and reject modified algebra even when artifact hashes are recomputed?

claims.text: Both selected sealed local software cells retain exact chain inputs and pass native verify; the copied cell passes hash-only status but fails native semantic verification.

No PDP solve requirement, independent ECDLP recovery, FFD/LFD certificate, timing or statistical comparison, model-training result, cloud durability, startup-gate execution, or corpus completion follows from this software fixture.

literature.claim: Prime chain leaves use the exact signed factor-base abscissae and auxiliaries range over the field; affine-chain completion is not general PDP impossibility.
literature.verified_by: Read the frozen contract and its prior primary-source review; no new mathematical mechanism is proposed.

literature.claim: Use the actual PlanArgs, GenerateArgs, verify_protocol, mixed-radix cell indexing, central replay and status contracts.
literature.verified_by: Read current implementation and TempRun.bound before authoring this fixture.

arms.description: Natural native generated targets on exactly two fixed local software cells; no target planting or resampling.

instrument.binding_rule: Require exact source_commit and binary_sha256 arguments, check native clean preflight before generation, then check both retained run bindings and hash the binary before/after each command.

aa.not_applicable_reason: Exact software assertions only; no timing or statistical effect is estimated.

positive.expected_detection: The intact generated cells are accepted by central native replay; this is a verifier acceptance control, not a planted PDP solution.

negative.null_population: Software control only: one copied shard62 cell has its auxiliary domain and one S3 coefficient changed, with all manifest artifact hashes and sizes recomputed.
negative.expected_detection: Hash-only native status accepts, then native verify rejects with prime F4 chain input differs at.

baseline.not_applicable_reason: No before/after algorithm or performance comparison is requested.

primary.definition: Recorded pass/fail of fixed CLI provenance, integrity and semantic-replay assertions.

execution.cancellation: SIGINT/SIGTERM set an atomic flag; command watchdog or cancellation kills and reaps the child process group immediately. SIGKILL, host loss or storage failure require retained-process/output reconciliation.

checkpoint.policy: retain every emitted local file and command prefix

retries.note: Stop on first failed required assertion and retain all files. A new attempt requires a separately recorded fresh output path.

stopping_rules.rule: At most two native generation calls, each max_cases1, in separate shards62/64 and63/64. No additional cell generation or resume.
Stop after any unexpected exit, timeout, binding mismatch, missing chain input, failed intact replay, or incorrect tamper result. No replacement target or weakened assertion.

decision_rule.text: Pass only when both intact selected cells satisfy all exact assertions and the copied/rehashed corruption is rejected semantically. PDP success is neither required nor inferred.

outputs: complete native output and tampered-copy directories
